passed_observations: Strict public policy/preparation/admission schemas reject extra execution fields and bound resources, recipe context, checks, preview count and lifetime.

Fresh owner policy creation captures the current numeric repository/installation/source and exact project/environment revisions; revocation/expiry and source drift are checked after awaited source selection.
Current GitHub branch/PR origin, open state and installation access are independently queried; webhook signatures alone do not authorize delivery.
Shared Foundation mappings bind exact manifest, plan, run, lease/fence/epoch, target generation and provider binding; default source/provider absence is unavailable.
Build and deployment evidence require strict booleans and canonical scope/digest/provenance; readiness precedes promotion.
Preview creation is server-owned and synthetic-only; cleanup is limited to preview runtime/ingress and does not implement PostgreSQL/persistent-data purge.
Unknown physical intentions retain the target lock and capacity; there is no blind retry from the normal execute path.

resolved_findings.evidence: packages/core/src/delivery-preparation.ts:71-76 accepts retained release/rollback artifacts by cell/recipe and release ciRunId; packages/core/src/delivery-execution.ts:38-46 validates artifact provider evidence against original.manifest. packages/core/src/delivery-evidence.ts:20-22 checks requiredChecks and configurationHash only against the supplied manifest, which here is the original build manifest rather than the current release policy.
resolved_findings.expected: Every release satisfies the required checks and compatible configuration of its current exact delivery policy, including when selecting retained artifacts.
resolved_findings.observed: Static data flow does not check the current policy's requiredChecks or current configurationHash when reusing an artifact. A retained artifact built for a policy requiring test can be selected under another same-cell/same-recipe policy requiring test plus an additional check; the original manifest still supplies the validation requirements. Original build limits similarly supply the configuration hash comparison.
resolved_findings.verification: Confirmed by reading both artifact selection and consumption paths; not reproduced by a new executable scenario. Existing managed tests validate evidence against one manifest and do not cover current-policy versus original-policy artifact reuse.
resolved_findings.refutation: Immutable prior provenance is necessary and allows eligible rollback, but it does not establish that the current policy's mandatory checks ran or current configuration compatibility was assessed. Same recipe and CI source do not imply the same required checks or configuration requirements.
resolved_findings.suggestion: Retain original provenance validation and also validate reusable artifact eligibility against current release/rollback policy check and configuration requirements, with explicit compatibility semantics.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current-policy required checks/configuration are now checked at preparation and again before stage. Existing delivery-rollback.test.ts passes all four cases, including additional-check release/rollback refusal and configuration drift.

resolved_findings.evidence: packages/core/src/foundation-effects.ts:166,194,202 calls environmentFor without a delivery-cleanup allowance during reconciliation. packages/core/src/foundation-data.ts:124-126 rejects expired and cleanup-required previews under that default. In contrast foundation-data.ts:193-200 explicitly permits the exact cleanup command during execution lease validation.
resolved_findings.expected: An unknown outcome from an exact owned preview cleanup can enter read-only reconciliation after TTL expiry or verified PR closure, while ordinary deployment and recovery activation remain blocked.
resolved_findings.observed: Static control flow rejects such a reconciliation before invoking its provider adapter. A cleanup lost receipt on a closing/expired preview therefore cannot be independently inspected through Foundation.reconcile, leaving its target lock and reservation unresolved.
resolved_findings.verification: Confirmed default arguments and unconditional guard path by source inspection. No new scenario executed. Existing local laboratory receipt checks inspect the provider directly and do not exercise Foundation.reconcile on an expired preview.
resolved_findings.refutation: The delivery cleanup manifest and execution paths deliberately allow expired preview cleanup, but that exception does not apply to the separate shared reconciliation entry and post-I/O guards. Ordinary preview admission restrictions should remain intact.
resolved_findings.suggestion: Give only exact scoped read-only delivery cleanup reconciliation the required closing/expired-preview access; preserve recovery HOLD, ownership, fence and absence checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: Foundation reconciliation now allows retained delivery inspection for closing/expired previews while retaining recovery HOLD and exact adapter scope/fence checks. Existing delivery-preview-faults.test.ts passes four cases, including no-repeat reconciliation after expiry and HOLD denial.

resolved_findings.evidence: packages/core/src/delivery-execution.ts:144-149 records released and returns failed without evidenceRef when no delivery step exists. packages/core/src/foundation-effects.ts:75-90 converts terminal outcomes missing evidenceRef to unknown. packages/core/src/delivery-settlement.ts:10-15 releases the lane only for failed plus released, but the shared settlement receives unknown instead.
resolved_findings.expected: A positively known denial before a durable physical intention is terminal without retaining an uncertain physical-resource reservation; failures after a physical intention remain unknown until reconciled.
resolved_findings.observed: Static outcome composition converts the explicitly no-step failure to EVIDENCE_MISSING/unknown, so the delivery settlement cannot clear its pending target. Source or policy rejection before the first intention therefore follows the same unresolved path as an ambiguous external effect.
resolved_findings.verification: Confirmed by following the adapter return through Foundation.settle and delivery settlement. No new executable scenario or proof code was written.
resolved_findings.refutation: Conservatively retaining truly uncertain effects is correct. Here the implementation itself establishes that no durable delivery step exists and records released; returning no durable no-effect evidence prevents the intended terminal branch from ever applying to this path.
resolved_findings.suggestion: Return verifiable durable no-effect evidence for the known pre-intention denial, consistent with Foundation's existing terminal-outcome evidence rule.
resolved_findings.resolution: Known no-intention failure now returns a durable delivery-no-dispatch evidence reference. Static composition reaches failedWithoutEffect release; existing execution tests passed, though they do not explicitly assert the target-release branch for this exact denial.
